text:
ana: quick ping — opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4123 with a tiny rename + gofumpt diff. Need one approval and a quick sanity check on the public vs internal name change.
ken: skimming — looks small. what's the public surface impact?
ana: typo — i'm ana :facepalm: public surface is zero for customers, but a few exported helpers in internal packages used by other infra packages. it's mostly renames like `RequestCtx` -> `CallCtx`.
ken: ok. if it's only internal packages we can proceed but prefer a compatibility alias for one release. can you add `type RequestCtx = CallCtx` and deprecate comment?
sam: fyi re: formatter, run `gofumpt -w ./pkg ./cmd` before pushing, CI failed on fmt in my run.
ana: thanks — pushed a fixup with gofumpt applied. also added the compatibility alias and comment: `// Deprecated: use CallCtx. Will be removed in v0.28`
ken: sweet. one tiny nit: the alias should live next to the original type so imports don't change. move it to pkg/core/context.go?
maria: i can do the move if ana wants to hand off. also saw import-order lint in `pkg/api` after the rename — goimports rearranged one import group, CI flagged it.
ana: handing off to you, thanks. maria — any chance you can bundle that with the move and trigger a new CI?
maria: sure. i'll push a small commit that moves the alias and runs `gofumpt` + `goimports`. expect a tiny semver note in the changelog entry.
deploy-bot: Buildkite: #4123 — build failed on fmt check (step "gofmt-check").
ana: thanks for the bot ping. i already pushed the gofumpt fix, but i'm going to rebase to squash the fmt commit.
maria: pushed move + fmt fixes in commit 3a7b2f7. PTAL.
ken: took a look — codewise LGTM. one doc nit in pkg/core/context.go: comment should mention why alias exists (cross-package transition).
sam: small: please run `make generate` for the protobuf bindings, CI showed a generated file diff in `gen/` after the rename.
maria: ah yeah, missed that. i'll regenerate and force-add the generated files.
ana: thanks all. once CI is green can someone add the second approval? @ken?
ken: will add my approval after green CI. :thumbsup:
maria: CI passing now — all checks green.
ken: approved. merge when ready. :shipit:
ana: merging now, will monitor main for 10m for any regressions and follow up in #eng if something pops. thanks everyone!
maria: nice, thanks for quick turnaround.
ana: (note) i'll add a short note to the release notes about the compatibility alias and planned removal in v0.28.
